rationale: The agent submitted returns without explicit user confirmation, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. It did not clearly authenticate the user beyond an email lookup. It also failed to honor the user’s request to refund each order to the opposite payment method or to explain/confirm alternatives; instead it processed refunds to the original methods without consent. If opposite-method refunds are not possible, the agent should have clarified and, if needed, handed off to a human. While actions appear to target the correct user/orders and the final info matches the tool calls, the missing authentication and confirmation and failure to address the requested refund routing constitute policy violations.
